title: Application to Study Permit Process Steps for Lithuania
notice: Lithuania has no Embassy in Bangladesh — nearest Lithuanian Embassy is in New Delhi, India. Apply via VFS Global Dhaka or in person at the Embassy in Delhi.

processSteps.label: University Application : via admissions.lt or university portal
bullets: admissions.lt covers most major Lithuanian universities
Application window: March–June for September intake

processSteps.label: Offer / Admission Letter
bullets: Tuition: €1,500–€6,000/year | Lithuanian Government Scholarship can waive fees entirely

processSteps.label: Financial Proof : ~€4,800–€8,000 in bank
bullets: Bank statement must clearly show your name and balance

processSteps.label: Book Student Housing / Dormitory
bullets: Housing confirmation required for visa application

processSteps.label: Arrange Health Insurance
bullets: Mandatory for visa — must cover entire study period

processSteps.label: Lithuanian Embassy New Delhi : National D Visa Application
bullets: No Lithuanian Embassy in Bangladesh — apply via Embassy New Delhi or VFS Global Dhaka

processSteps.label: Arrive in Lithuania — Register for Residence Permit
bullets: Register at Migration Department within 30 days of arrival
Obtain Lithuanian personal code (asmens kodas) for banking and work

costSteps.label: Lithuanian National D Visa Fee : €80 — paid at Embassy or VFS
Financial Proof in Bank : ~€4,800–€8,000 — your own money, not a fee
University Application Fee : €0–30 depending on university
Air Ticket to Lithuania : varies by season and route
